ownRead.body:
## Start with the definition authority

- [00 — Locked core](/documents/locked-core/): normative definitions, structural recursion and the explicit open-extension boundaries.
- [05 — Research and change control](/changes/): classification of research and the proof gate for a proposed definition change.

- [Current source changelog](/changes/source-history/): adopted source repairs and its evidence-only update.

## Then read the implementations and tests

- [02 — Scientific framework](/framework/): non-normative propositions, source-reported support and research programme.
- [03 — Candidate mathematics](/math/): model assumptions, equations, proposed experiments and retained addenda.
- [04 — Research status](/research-status/), [06/07/08 evidence](/evidence/) and [open questions](/open-problems/): what is reported and what remains to be demonstrated.

Each reading retains its supplied edition and source context. The source body is rendered from the original document rather than maintained as a separate website copy. [Start](/start/) offers a simpler reading path.

## Current and historical work

The v0.1a/v0.1b addenda retained inside the current mathematical document belong to that supplied edition. Its candidate calculations and experiments are proposals, not results executed by this website. The separate historical cavity/response-reduction calculations are not selected for this edition’s website; they are not presented as evidence for the current programme.
